Cooking: 12 minutes|difficulty=2}} {{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Italy|Italian cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Seafood|Seafood]] | [[Cookbook:Pasta|Pasta]] ==Ingredients== * 1 package (12 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) [[Cookbook:Shrimp|shrimp scampi]], garlic and butter flavor * 12 ounces dry [[Cookbook:Pasta|angel hair pasta]] * ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] fresh [[Cookbook:Parsley|flat-leaf parsley leaves]], roughly [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] * ⅓ cup [[Cookbook:Pine Nut|pine nuts]], [[cookbook:toast|toasted]] * Finely grated [[Cookbook:Zest|zest]] and [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|juice of 1 lemon]] * [[Cookbook:Kosher|Kosher]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]] and freshly ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]] ==Procedure== # [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] large pot of cold [[Cookbook:Water|water]] and salt it generously. # Add the pasta and cook, stirring occasionally until [[Cookbook:Al Dente|al dente]], 4–5 minutes. # Drain the pasta reserving about 1 cup of the cooking water. # Prepare the shrimp in a large [[Cookbook:Skillet|skillet]] according to package directions. # Stir the lemon zest and juice into the shrimp. # Add the pasta, reserved pasta water, parsley and pine nuts, and [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|toss]] in the skillet to coat the pasta evenly. # Divide shrimp and pasta among warm pasta bowls and serve. steps.text: Boil large pot of cold water and salt it generously.
Add the pasta and cook, stirring occasionally until al dente, 4–5 minutes.
Drain the pasta reserving about 1 cup of the cooking water.
Prepare the shrimp in a large skillet according to package directions.
Stir the lemon zest and juice into the shrimp.
Add the pasta, reserved pasta water, parsley and pine nuts, and toss in the skillet to coat the pasta evenly.
Divide shrimp and pasta among warm pasta bowls and serve.
